sloka: पुत्रः संतर्जितो वाग्भिः न त्राता मैथिली कथम् ।तस्या विलपितम् श्रुत्वा तौ च सीता वियोजितौ ॥४-६३-७॥
transliteration: putraḥ saṁtarjito vāgbhiḥ na trātā maithilī katham ।tasyā vilapitam śrutvā tau ca sītā viyojitau ॥4-63-7॥

translations.english: 'Even after hearing the wailing of Sita, knowing that both (Rama and Lakshmana) are separated from her and considering my friendship with Dasaratha, I felt displeased with my son (as he did not make an attempt to rescue her)'.
translations.hindi: पातालवासी दानवेन्द्रो से युक्त, रोमाञ्चकारी समुद्र को देख बानरश्रेषछ घबराए और उदास हुए
